title: Stochastic linear-quadratic control problem for regime-switching jump-diffusion system and its application to finance
summary: This paper investigates a stochastic linear-quadratic (SLQ) control problem for a regime-switching jump-diffusion system. Unlike traditional regime-switching diffusion systems that couple a diffusion process with a Markov chain, we incorporate the jumps of the Markov chain into the state equation. This modeling methodology effectively captures potential gains or losses of the system during the regime transitions. It should be noted that the introduction of Markov chain jumps into the state equation leads to increased complexity in the corresponding coupled differential Riccati equations…
